dedupe_keys.name: open smelter resolved spatial prior for cf4 pfc 14 emissions with a 94 smelter primary aluminium registry

description: This dataset is an open spatial prior for CF4 emissions from primary aluminium smelting, gridded by smelter location, together with the open registry behind it. The Zenodo record says the registry has 95 rows for 94 smelters plus one idle plant, with coordinates, nameplate capacity, 2020 operating status and source notes, and that the gridded weights come in capacity, presence-only and production-rescaled variants at 0.1 degree for Europe and 1 degree globally, with a method note and README. It was published by independent researcher Zach Dissington (version 3, June 2026) under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as NetCDF files. Coverage is global for 2020. Caveats: values are relative weights, not emissions, zero outside smelter cells, the technology column is empty, and the record reports only modest agreement with atmospheric inversions. For simulation it gives a geolocated aluminium smelter layer with capacities for supply chain, power demand and emissions studies. Related catalogue records include the CBAM-sector global facility registry and Climate TRACE.
name: Open smelter-resolved spatial prior for CF4 (PFC-14) emissions, with a 94-smelter primary aluminium registry
